item.title: Google Fined $36 Million Over Anti-Competitive Deals With Australia Telcos

media:content.media:description: Google said it was pleased to have resolved the regulator's concerns. (File pic)

item.description: Google has agreed to pay a Aus$55 million (US$36 million) penalty for striking "anti-competitive" deals to pre-install only its own search engine on Android mobile phones sold by two leading Australian telecoms firms.

item.title: Italy's Ventina Glacier Has Melted Beyond On-Site Monitoring: Geologists
